metadata.description: Adrien's Claude Code skills: developer (plan-and-execute) and campaign (ReAct) families, engineering docs, résumé tailoring, plus pinned picks from Anthropic.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Developer family, plan-and-execute: plan, implement, review and investigate a ticket with Opus planning and judging and Sonnet executing and checking. Plus model and effort routing advice.

plugins.name: campaign-kit
plugins.description: Campaign family, ReAct: interview, run parallel lanes in rounds, review and iterate until measurable done criteria are met, with Opus judging and Sonnet executing and checking.

plugins.name: docs-kit
plugins.description: Archon twin docs: one fact base rendered as an HTML page for engineers and a Markdown file for coding agents.

plugins.name: career-kit
plugins.description: Truthful, job-tailored résumés for a resume-forge checkout.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Anthropic. Create and improve skills, run evals, tune descriptions for triggering. Use it to evolve the skills in this marketplace.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Anthropic. Skills and agents for writing Claude Code plugins: structure, agents, skills, hooks, commands, MCP.

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Anthropic. /commit, /commit-push-pr and branch cleanup: the step after a dev-kit review approves.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Anthropic. Security warnings on edits and an LLM diff review at the end of each turn. Opt-in: the per-turn review spends tokens.

plugins.name: project-artifact
plugins.description: Anthropic. A living, shareable status page for multi-workstream work; pairs with campaign-kit reports.

plugins.name: webapp-testing
plugins.description: Anthropic. Drive a local web app with Playwright to verify UI behaviour; gives checkers a way to prove front-end acceptance criteria.
